summary: Dark Bramble is the fifth planet from the Sun, a network of twisted vines and space-bending teleportation passages — the imploded remnants of a former ice planet now overrun by plant growth. It is the only planet with hostile wildlife (the Anglerfish) and contains The Vessel, Feldspar's camp, and the lost Escape Pod 3.

biology: Dark Bramble's interior has zero gravity.
Dark Bramble's exterior has approximately 0.4 g of gravity.
Dark Bramble is the only planet in the solar system that features hostile wildlife.
Dark Bramble's exterior consists of an enormous seed covered with numerous glowing openings, surrounded by thick fog.
Thick vines branch from the central seed, connecting to imploded fragments of an ice crust.
The interior of Dark Bramble contains expansive spaces far larger than its exterior would indicate, due to space-bending properties.
Each interior node is an enormous enclosed zero-gravity space filled with long winding vines and thick fog that impairs vision.
Dark Bramble seeds emit visible light through the fog, with two exceptions: the Nomai Grave seed and the Vessel Node seeds emit no light.
Dark Bramble seeds come in two sizes: large seeds with openings wide enough for a spaceship, and small seeds only large enough for a Scout.
behavior: Pieces of light from Dark Bramble seeds and Anglerfish lures look identical, making them indistinguishable at a distance.
Signals from objects inside Dark Bramble nodes can be detected from outside via the Signalscope and Scout Launcher.
Duplicate signals can appear when multiple seeds and openings lead to the same node.
The Vessel emits a beacon that, due to Dark Bramble's space-bending, can be detected as originating from multiple locations simultaneously.
Anglerfish in Dark Bramble are generally inactive and still until awakened by sound.
Anglerfish are blind and rely on sound to hunt their prey.
location: Dark Bramble is the fifth planet from the Sun.
Dark Bramble was originally an ice planet before being infected and torn apart by the space-bending plant growth.
Dark Bramble has eight unique interior nodes, interconnected by a network of seed portals.
The interior can be accessed by entering openings in the central seed at the planet's core.
A hidden Frozen Jellyfish is embedded in a crack of crust at Dark Bramble's South Pole.
The Hub Node is the first and most connected chamber of Dark Bramble.
The Hub Node contains a single Anglerfish waiting near its center.
The Hub Node has four seeds leading to the Nest, the Escape Pod Node, the Dead End Node, and Feldspar's Maze Node.
The Dead End Node contains no exit seeds and a single Anglerfish.
The Dead End Node can only be exited through its entrance opening.
The Escape Pod Node contains the lost Nomai Escape Pod 3 embedded in a thicket of vines.
The seed leading to the Escape Pod Node emits the Nomai distress signal.
The Escape Pod Node contains two Anglerfish and fragments of broken ice crust.
A trail of Nomai lights leads from Escape Pod 3 to the Nomai Grave.
The Nomai Grave is a hidden small seed in the Escape Pod Node that emits no light.
The Nomai Grave's seed is only large enough for a Scout to enter.
The Nomai Grave is surrounded by the suffocated corpses of the inhabitants of Escape Pod 3 and their final messages.
The Nomai Grave's seed leads to the Vessel Node.
Feldspar's Maze Node has nine distinct seeds and contains no Anglerfish.
Feldspar's Maze Node emits Feldspar's harmonica music.
Of the nine seeds in Feldspar's Maze, six lead to the Recursion Node and three lead to Feldspar's Camp.
Only the three Camp-bound seeds emit Feldspar's harmonica music.
Of the three seeds leading to Feldspar's Camp, only two are large enough for a ship; the third is small (Scout-sized).
The Recursion Node contains a single Anglerfish and a single seed that connects back to itself.
Flying into the Recursion Node's self-looping seed produces an infinite loop.
The Recursion Node can only be exited through its entrance opening.
Feldspar's Camp Node contains no Anglerfish.
Feldspar has set up camp inside an Anglerfish skeleton in this node.
The Anglerfish skeleton's light lure still functions and emits light.
The Anglerfish skeleton contains a small Dark Bramble Seed that the Anglerfish swallowed before dying.
Feldspar's damaged ship is parked near a hollow vine behind the skeleton.
The hollow vine behind Feldspar's ship leads back to the exterior of Dark Bramble, in the hidden crust section containing the Frozen Jellyfish.
The Nest Node is the largest and most dangerous node in Dark Bramble.
The seeds leading to the Nest Node glow bright red due to the Anglerfish eggs at the node's center.
The Nest Node is guarded by five Anglerfish.
Three of the Nest Node's Anglerfish are always positioned at the node's entrance.
The Nest Node contains four seeds: three lead back to the Recursion Node, and one leads to the Vessel Node.
The Vessel Node seed within the Nest Node is hidden among the vines and emits no light.
The Vessel Node contains The Vessel, the final resting place of the Nomai's spaceship.
The Vessel Node contains no Anglerfish.
The Vessel sits in the center of the node, entangled in a thicket of vines.
Seeds leading to the Vessel Node emit no light.
lore: Dark Bramble was originally a fifth ice planet in the solar system.
Dark Bramble grew into the space of the destroyed fifth planet and destroyed it from the inside-out.
The Jellyfish were originally inhabitants of the destroyed fifth planet before Dark Bramble's growth.
Feldspar, a lost member of Outer Wilds Ventures, lives in Feldspar's Camp Node deep within Dark Bramble.
Feldspar's Camp Node is reached by following Feldspar's harmonica music with the Signalscope or by launching a Scout into the Dark Bramble Seed on Timber Hearth.
The Frozen Jellyfish provides a clue for reaching the core of Giant's Deep, and Feldspar's notes about it elaborate the mechanism.
Feldspar attempted to eat the Frozen Jellyfish, found the outer rubbery layer inedible, and concluded the jellyfish are only useful for electrical insulation.
Escape Pod 3 was the only one of the Vessel's three Escape Pods to fail to escape Dark Bramble.
The crew of Escape Pod 3 left the pod when air ran low to seek the nearest Vessel beacon.
The Nomai Grave records Secca's final message: the seed leading to the Vessel was too small for a Nomai to enter, but the Vessel's beacon was still faintly emitting from within it.
Secca theorized that the gruesome place could manipulate space itself, which may have been their undoing.
The Vessel is an ancient Nomai spaceship that was damaged and evacuated shortly after the Nomai's arrival in the solar system.
The Vessel originally followed a signal from the Eye of the Universe but exited warp inside Dark Bramble instead of at the signal source.
mechanics: When traveling through a Dark Bramble seed, the player enters the destination node at a reduced fixed speed and a fixed direction, regardless of inbound angle or speed.
Returning through a node's entrance opening (embedded in the walls of the current node) returns the player to the exterior of the planet.
Firing a Scout into a small seed reveals the duplicate Scout signal, which can be used to locate the same node from a different seed.
The seed leading to the Vessel Node within the Nest Node can be reliably found by following Escape Pod 3's trail to the Nomai Grave and firing a Scout into the small seed there.
Anglerfish are awakened by sound from any kind of thrusters or by launching probes too close to them.
Further sound after an Anglerfish is awakened enrages it, causing it to charge faster than a spaceship can accelerate.
Following Feldspar's harmonica music with a Signalscope leads to the seed entering Feldspar's Camp Node.
Launching a Scout into the Dark Bramble Seed on Timber Hearth and following the Scout's location also leads to Feldspar's Camp Node.
Escape Pod 3 can be located by tracking its distress signal with the Signalscope.
The Vessel can be located by following Escape Pod 3's light trail to the Nomai Grave seed, shooting a Scout through it, and following the Scout's pings.
The Frozen Jellyfish is reached by asking Feldspar about Giant's Deep, then following the hollow vine behind Feldspar's ship.
